title: Riley clone PageSpec
description: Generation-ready page composition for the Riley clone design-repo. Every node is one section instance; closed type/template/motion/assetRole enums; additionalProperties:false everywhere. `x-maxWords` is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (JSON Schema cannot count words). No PageSpec field carries a URL/href: links are expressed as assetRole only.
